title.en: The House on Elm Street (Nadia Bush)

text.en: A lonely house at the roadside keeps its secret.

The poem describes a mysterious house that sits alone. Nobody knows what happened inside. At night the lights seem to flicker, and the speaker, who drives past almost every day, is tempted to look closer but fear takes over. Beside the house stands a tree that never grows leaves in any season.
The poem builds mystery and fear through its images. Rumours grow and the house begins to fade, and the speaker never finds out the truth, which leaves the reader curious.
Notice the irregular rhymes and the use of mood words like mysterious, flicker and rumours.
